label: Ashby
description: Arcade.dev tools for interacting with Ashby

tools.name: AddCandidateNote
tools.description:
Add a plain-text note to a candidate (e.g. an agent handoff or summary).

Creates a new note each time it runs. Requires the Candidates write permission
on the API key.

parameters.name: candidate_id
parameters.description: The id of the candidate to add the note to.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: The note text to add. Sent as plain text; do not pass HTML markup.

parameters.name: send_notifications
parameters.description: Whether users subscribed to the candidate are notified of the note. Defaults to False.

note.value: Candidate spoke with recruiter on initial screening call. Strong background in backend engineering with 5+ years of experience. Recommended to move forward to technical interview stage.

tools.name: ArchiveApplication
tools.description:
Archive (reject) an application, recording why.

This is how Ashby rejects a candidate for a job: the application moves to its
interview plan's archived stage with an archive reason. Resolves the reason name
to the organization's configured reason id for you — an unknown name errors with
the available reasons, and an ambiguous one errors rather than guessing. Does NOT
email the candidate. The application's data is preserved, and it can later be
moved back to an active stage to un-archive it — though anything the rejection
already triggered (notifications, a status visible to humans) is not undone.
Requires the Candidates write, Interviews read, and hiring-process-metadata read
permissions on the API key.

parameters.name: application_id
parameters.description: The id of the application to archive (reject).

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The NAME of the archive reason to record, e.g. 'Candidate withdrew' or 'Not enough experience'. Resolved to the organization's configured reason id for you; if it doesn't match, the error lists the available reasons.

output.description: The application after it was archived.

tools.name: ChangeApplicationStage
tools.description:
Move an application to a named interview stage, in either direction.

Resolves the stage name to its id inside the application's own interview plan,
then moves the application — you do not look up stage ids yourself. Works to
advance or to move a candidate back; if the name does not match, the error lists
the plan's available stage names, and an ambiguous name (two stages share it)
errors rather than guessing. Records a transition each time it runs. It cannot
move an application into an archived/rejected stage (Ashby requires an archive
reason this tool does not collect). Requires the Candidates write and Interviews
read permissions on the API key.

parameters.name: application_id
parameters.description: The id of the application to move.

parameters.name: to_stage
parameters.description: The NAME of the destination interview stage, e.g. 'Onsite'. Resolved to the stage id for you within the application's interview plan.

output.description: The application after the stage change.

tools.name: GetCandidate
tools.description:
Get a candidate's profile and the ids of their applications.

Use the returned application ids with feedback or application tools; the Ashby
API does not list a candidate's applications directly. Requires the Candidates
read permission on the API key.

parameters.name: candidate_id
parameters.description: The id of the candidate to fetch.

output.description: The candidate's profile and the ids of their applications.

tools.name: GetCandidateDebrief
tools.description:
Gather everything about a candidate for a debrief in one call.

Pulls the candidate's profile, the notes on file, and the interview feedback and
scorecards across each of their applications, then returns them together — you do
not chain the candidate, note, and feedback reads yourself. Feedback covers up to
the candidate's first applications when there are many; an application whose
feedback can't be read is counted in `feedback_failed` rather than failing the
whole call. Requires the Candidates read permission on the API key.

parameters.name: candidate_id
parameters.description: The id of the candidate to gather a debrief for.

output.description: The candidate's profile, notes, and interview feedback across their applications.

tools.name: ListApplicationFeedback
tools.description:
Read the feedback and interview scorecards submitted on an application.

Useful for synthesizing what reviewers said about a candidate before a debrief.
Requires the Candidates read permission on the API key.

parameters.name: application_id
parameters.description: The id of the application whose feedback and interview scorecards to read.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Defaults to the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of feedback items to return on this page (1-100). Defaults to 50.

output.description: Feedback / scorecards submitted on the application.

tools.name: ListApplications
tools.description:
List the organization's applications, optionally filtered by job and/or status.

The Ashby API does not filter applications by candidate; to find a specific
candidate's applications, read the candidate first and use its application ids.
Requires the Candidates read permission on the API key.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Return only applications to this job. Defaults to all jobs.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Return only applications in this status. Defaults to any status.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Defaults to the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of applications to return on this page (1-100). Defaults to 50.

output.description: A page of the organization's applications.

tools.name: ListCandidateNotes
tools.description:
Read the notes recorded on a candidate, paginated via the cursor.

Requires the Candidates read permission on the API key.

parameters.name: candidate_id
parameters.description: The id of the candidate whose notes to read.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Defaults to the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notes to return on this page (1-100). Defaults to 50.

output.description: A page of the candidate's notes.

tools.name: ListJobs
tools.description:
List the organization's jobs (roles), optionally filtered by status.

A job is the role record; headcount slots ("openings") are a separate concept
not exposed here. Requires the Jobs read permission on the API key.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter to jobs with these statuses. Defaults to every status.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Defaults to the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs to return on this page (1-100). Defaults to 50.

output.description: A page of the organization's jobs.

tools.name: SearchCandidates
tools.description:
Search the organization's candidates by name and/or email.

Intended for narrowing to a small set of known candidates (e.g. re-engaging a
past applicant). Returns at most 100 matches; provide at least one of name or
email, each at least 3 characters. Requires the Candidates read permission on
the API key.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Full or partial candidate name to match. Combined with email using AND when both are given. Defaults to searching by email only.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Candidate email address to match. Combined with name using AND when both are given. Defaults to searching by name only.

output.description: Candidates across the organization matching the search (capped at 100 by the API).

summary:
Arcade's Ashby toolkit lets agents read and write recruiting data in an Ashby ATS — searching candidates, managing applications, and collecting interview feedback.

## Capabilities

- **Candidate lookup & profiles** — search candidates by name/email, fetch full profiles, and retrieve application IDs for downstream calls.
- **Application lifecycle management** — list applications (filtered by job/status), advance or rewind interview stages, and archive (reject) applications with a resolved archive reason.
- **Notes & feedback** — add plain-text notes to candidates, read paginated candidate notes, and retrieve interview scorecards/feedback per application.
- **Job listing** — list the organization's jobs filtered by status; exposes role records (not headcount slots).
- **Debrief aggregation** — `GetCandidateDebrief` fetches profile, notes, and all application feedback in a single call, avoiding manual chaining.

## Secrets

`ASHBY_API_KEY` — An Ashby API key used to authenticate every request. Generate one in your Ashby account under **Settings → Integrations → API Keys** (requires admin access). The key must be granted the specific permissions each tool needs:

- **Candidates read** — required by all read operations (search, get candidate/debrief, list notes/feedback/applications).
- **Candidates write** — required by note creation, stage changes, and archiving.
- **Interviews read** — required by stage changes and archiving.
- **Jobs read** — required by job listing.
- **Hiring-process-metadata read** — required by archiving.

Scope the key to only the permissions your agent actually needs. See [Ashby's API key documentation](https://developers.ashbyhq.com/docs/authentication) for details on creating and scoping keys.

Store the secret in Arcade at https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets. For general guidance on secrets in Arcade tools, see https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets.
